entities.summary: Harriet Maxine Hageman is an American politician and attorney serving as the U.S. representative for Wyoming's at-large congressional district since 2023. She is a member of the Republican Party. Harriet Hageman was a legal figures from Douglas (b. 1962-10-18, Douglas). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
